problem_type: Shared tool guidance must survive every external publication path
symptom: Actual tools/list canvas description omits prompt-writing guidance after field-description compaction.
direct_cause: Capability resolver rereads the contract short description instead of publishing the shared description with guidelines; the collapsed read tool discards its source description.
class_root: The metadata projection boundary did not preserve the model-visible guidance contract through adapter and aggregate publication.
affected_population: External MCP callers of all six shared model-facing profiles
Canvas read through the approved nomi_read aggregate
internal_only_reason: The MCP description wire field and protocol are unchanged; the failure is an internal string projection ignoring existing shared metadata.
invariants: Each externally published shared tool retains all its applicable promptGuidelines.
Aggregated canvas read guidance remains scoped to target=canvas.
Tools without descriptors retain their own contract description, with no invented descriptors.
generality_proof: One shared description formatter is used by profile projection and real capability resolver; aggregate read incorporates only its actual canvas read source description.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Derive the contract description plus deduplicated shared guideline text.
Keep source guidance in the approved aggregate with explicit target scope.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Actual semantic tools use the shared description formatter and MCP-profile specs.
The single collapsed canvas read tool carries the actual source description under target=canvas.

recurrence.reason: Any shared descriptor guideline could disappear at either publication edge independently of tool domain.
same_class_scan: Searched mcpProfileTools/MCP_TOOL_RESOLVER/promptGuidelines/description across shared registry, adapter, catalog and protocol.
Enumerated actual shared MCP profiles: asset.read, canvas.read/write, document.read/write, timeline.read.
Read actual tools/list protocol dispatch and approved canvas read aggregation.

prevention.invariant: Each externally published shared tool retains all its applicable promptGuidelines.
prevention.failure_mode: Shared missing projection metadata still throws; applicable guidance is always derived at publication.
prevention.strategy: Use the existing shared formatter at both publication boundaries and preserve aggregate provenance scope.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace existing short-only derivation in place; no parallel metadata publisher or new runtime path.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency or external format change; only internal metadata propagation.

migration: No persisted data or wire shape changes. New tools/list responses retain the existing guideline text.
residual_risks: Live third-party host model behavior is not exercised; tests verify the real deterministic tools/list wire response.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The shared description owner must serve both internal MCP profile projection and actual external publication.
